avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: MAO inhibition and serotonin elevation; increased risk of serotonin syndrome
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; discontinue St. John's Wort at least 2 weeks before starting zolmitriptan

avoid_supplements.name: 5-HTP
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Direct serotonin precursor; additive serotonergic effects increase serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid combination; use alternative migraine prevention if needed

avoid_supplements.name: L-Tryptophan
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Serotonin precursor; enhanced serotonergic activity with triptan
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent supplementation during triptan therapy

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mild serotonergic activity; theoretical additive effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia); use lowest effective dose

caution_supplements.name: Caffeine supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild vasoconstrictor; additive vasoconstrictive effects with triptan
caution_supplements.action: Limit caffeine intake to <200 mg daily; monitor blood pressure and headache frequency

avoid_foods.name: Broad beans (fava beans)
avoid_foods.mechanism: High tyramine content; risk of hypertensive crisis when combined with serotonergic agents
avoid_foods.action: Avoid or limit consumption; educate patient on tyramine-rich foods

caution_foods.name: Aged cheeses, cured meats
caution_foods.mechanism: Tyramine content; potential mild vasoconstrictive interactions
caution_foods.action: Moderate consumption; monitor for headache exacerbation or blood pressure elevation

caution_foods.name: Chocolate
caution_foods.mechanism: Contains phenylethylamine and small amounts of serotonin; may trigger migraines independently
caution_foods.action: Identify if chocolate is a personal migraine trigger; avoid if patient-specific sensitivity exists

caution_foods.name: High-caffeine beverages (energy drinks, excessive coffee)
caution_foods.mechanism: Vasoconstrictor effects; additive with triptan vasomotor activity
caution_foods.action: Limit to <200 mg caffeine daily; monitor for cardiovascular symptoms

monitoring_notes: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, rapid heart rate, hyperthermia, muscle rigidity) especially if other serotonergic agents are used concurrently. Assess for vasoconstrictive side effects (chest tightness, palpitations) and counsel on proper triptan dosing (maximum 10 mg per dose, 30 mg/24 hours).
